(a) the Fleshler and Hoffmann equation can be used to calculate VI schedule value, (b) the values are easily generated by a simple BASIC program, (c) the values can be randomized, (d) the values are saved to a disk file, and (e) the values can subsequently be used to generate a variable interval schedule of reinforcement.
